title: Exact constant-scalar restriction on derived module sheaves
statement: For a scheme X and an arbitrary commutative ring A, the exact equivalence obtained by restriction from modules over the constant ring sheaf to sheaves of ULift A-modules commutes with every cohomology functor, reflects each cohomological lower bound, and identifies intrinsic classicality with fixed-coefficient classicality. Classicality in the fixed presentation is invariant under derived isomorphisms. The two localization models are explicitly compared.

source.place: Opening and final paragraphs; constant-module presentation and exact cohomology; Stacks 093I, 03CY, 05RT

proof.text: Restriction along constant scalar sections retains pointwise addition; use the existing proved module equivalence to equip restriction with its equivalence instance. Derive the exact functor. Its cohomology comparison is the existing exact-functor comparison.

The exact faithful functor reflects zero cohomology objects and preserves them. Apply the cohomological characterization of IsGE degree by degree. To compare classicality, use the same underlying continuity maps, their naturality under sheaf isomorphisms, and the derived cohomology isomorphism. Identify the small-Hom and standard localizations by the fully faithful localization universal property.

theorem proEtaleDerivedModuleRestriction_classical_iff (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u)
    [CommRing A] (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    ProEtale.IsClassicalModuleComplex K ↔
      ProEtale.IsClassicalComplexFor X (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)
        ((proEtaleDerivedModuleRestriction X A).obj K)
